title: AI UGC Ads for Jewelry Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI UGC ads for jewelry from a photo of the ring or necklace. An actor wears it and says your line. See the credit cost, then download the file.
h1: AI UGC Ads for Jewelry, Worn on Camera
lead: Show the ring on a hand and the necklace at the collarbone, with an AI actor and a spoken line you approve. Earrings and bracelets can get the same worn ad.
card: One jewelry photo gives you a close-up, a worn shot, and a gift scene you can post.

faq.q: Can I make a jewelry UGC ad without booking a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can wear the ring, necklace, earring, or bracelet and deliver a spoken ad from one photo of the piece you ship. You approve the line before anyone posts it.

faq.q: How do I make a jewelry UGC ad?
faq.a: Upload a sharp photo of the piece, pick an AI actor, and approve the spoken line before you download. A failed job returns its credits, and the cost is on screen first.

faq.q: Can an AI actor wear the ring or the necklace?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar wears the necklace at the collarbone or the ring on a hand. Keep the frame on the piece you uploaded, and approve the line before the ad runs.

faq.q: How much does a jewelry video ad cost?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. A 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. You see the charge before it runs.

faq.q: Which placements can a jewelry ad use?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a gallery or a square post, and 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 when that placement asks for it. The same worn ad can also sit on the product page.

faq.q: Can I run the same jewelry ad in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the piece in the frame, write the line in the other language, and pick a voice for it. Check those words before you post the ad anywhere new.

faq.q: Can I use the jewelry ad in paid campaigns?
faq.a: Yes. You can place the file in paid campaigns and on your listings. It has no watermark. Compare the piece in the file with the one you ship before you publish.

faq.q: Can the ad show earrings and a bracelet as well?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for the earrings on an ear and the bracelet on a wrist, each from the photo of that piece. The actor wears what you uploaded, and you can make both in one project.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or my shop software?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send it from the shop software you already use. Ask for the bracelet on a wrist in one version and the necklace at the collarbone in another.
